panel.no_reply: No reply from the bot: press the button again
choice.no_such_button: That button does not match any option.
pile.where.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
pile.where.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
pile.instruction: {card}: take {how} out of your discard pile{kind}, put it {where} and press Done. I detect which one you moved.
pile.instruction_many: {card}: take {how} out of your discard pile{kind}, put them {where} and press Done. I detect which ones you moved.
pile.status: Move the card from your discard pile to your deck and press Done
pile.unreadable: I could not read your discard pile: press Done again.
pile.wrong: {titles} cannot be chosen with {card}: put it back in your discard pile and press Done.
pile.too_many: You took {n} cards out of the discard pile ({titles}) and you may take only {max}. Put the extra ones back and press Done.
pile.none: I do not see that you took any card out of your discard pile: take it, put it in your deck and press Done.
pile.too_few: I only see {n} card(s) out of the discard pile and you have to move {min}.
moves.where.adjacent: on a free space next to {who}
moves.where.nearest: on the free space nearest to {who}
moves.optional: (or press Don't move if you prefer to leave it where it is)
moves.put: {head}Put {name} on the board {where} and press Done.
moves.status.move: Move {name} on the table and press Done
moves.status.place: Place {name} on the table and press Done
moves.occupied: That space is occupied by {holder} ({spot}): move {name} to a free one.
moves.must_end: {name} has to end up {where}; it is now at {spot}.
moves.too_short: {name} moved {squares}; it has to move exactly {steps}.
moves.no_path: From where it was, {name} cannot reach that space in {squares} without passing through enemy fighters (this card does not allow it): find another path or another space.
moves.also_moved: {other} was also moved: put it back in its place ({spot}) and press Done.
moves.not_found: I cannot find the miniature of {name} on the table.
moves.off_board: {name} is off the board ({dist} from the nearest space): put it on a space and press Done.
hidden.start: You lost the combat with a card that lets you look at the bot's hand and choose {cards} for it to discard. Take it out of the green hand zone (Green) yourself to see it; put the chosen card face up on the bot's discard pile, put the rest back in its hand and press Done.
hidden.status: Discard 1 bot card by hand, put the rest back and press Done
hidden.foreign: That card is not from the bot's hand: its discard pile holds a card that is not its own ({titles}). Remove it and press Done.
hidden.extra_in_hand: The bot's hand holds cards that do not belong to it: {titles}. Remove them and press Done.
hidden.too_many: You discarded {n} cards; you may discard only 1 ({titles}). Put the extra ones back and press Done.
hidden.missing: Cards are missing from the bot's hand: put {titles} back in its hand (Green zone) and press Done.
hidden.nothing_yet: You have not discarded any card yet: put the chosen one face up on the bot's discard pile and press Done.
hidden.unseen: {titles} is on the discard pile but was not in the bot's hand: remove it and press Done.
hidden.discards: The bot discards {card} (the one you chose).
hidden.keeps_wildfire: The bot keeps {card} (Wildfire returns it to its hand).
hidden.empty_hand: You look at the bot's hand: it has no cards in hand.
hidden.not_visible: You look at the bot's hand, but I cannot see its cards on the table: ask it to show them.
hidden.row_pick: The bot puts its hand face up ({n} cards) and pings: choose one with a ping (Tab) on the card or with its panel button.
hidden.row_reveal: The bot puts its hand face up ({n} cards) and pings: you only look. Press End action or Cancel and it picks it up.
hidden.row_failed.pick: I could not put the bot's hand on the table: its cards are in the chat, choose with the panel buttons.
hidden.row_failed.reveal: I could not put the bot's hand on the table: its cards are in the chat.
hidden.row_failed.grant: I could not take the cards out of the bot's hand; repeat Look at bot's hand.
hidden.look_status.pick: Bot's hand in view: Tab on the card you choose, or its button
hidden.look_status.reveal: Bot's hand in view: End action or Cancel puts it away
hidden.look_status.grant: Bot's hand in view: Tab on the card to discard, or Cancel
hidden.resume.pick: The bot's hand is still in view: choose a card with a ping (Tab) or with its panel button.
hidden.resume.reveal: The bot's hand is still in view (look only): press End action or Cancel and it picks it up.
hidden.resume.grant: The bot's hand is still in view: ping (Tab) the card to discard or press Cancel.
hidden.ping_reveal: This time you only look: press End action or Cancel and the bot picks up its hand.
hidden.ping_not_now: That card cannot be chosen now.
hidden.close.discard_row: The bot discards {card} and puts the rest back in its hand.
hidden.close.discard_hand: The bot discards {card} (it was still in its hand) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.deck_row: {card} goes on top of the bot's deck; the rest goes back to its hand.
hidden.close.deck_hand: {card} goes on top of the bot's deck: it was still in its hand, put it on top of its deck yourself; the bot picks up its hand.
hidden.close.wildfire_kept: The bot keeps {card} (Wildfire returns it) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.kept_hits: The bot keeps {card} and {hits} and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.discard_bounce: The bot discards {card} (Wildfire returns it to its hand) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.kept: The bot keeps {card} and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.collect: The bot picks up its hand.
hidden.fail.not_in_row: that card was not in the row on the table
hidden.fail.not_in_discard: {card} is not yet visible on the bot's discard pile
hidden.fail.where_discard: and put {card} on its discard pile
hidden.fail.where_deck: and put {card} on top of its deck
hidden.fail.row: The table did not close the bot's row ({fail}): put its cards back in its hand{where}; press End action to sync.
hidden.ask_prediction: {card}: predict the printed value of the bot's card (you play it face up) or play it face down, with the panel buttons. The bot chooses its defense afterwards.
hidden.face_down: You play the card face down: no prediction.
hidden.predicted: You predict the bot's card has printed value {value}: your card is played face up.
hidden.intuition_notice: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has an active token: it spends it, draws 1 card and your attack is played face up. Put your card face down as usual and press Reveal: I turn it and the bot chooses its defense seeing it.
hidden.intuition_face_up: UNCANNY INTUITION: your attack is played face up: {card} (value {value}); the bot chooses its defense seeing it.
hidden.bot_predicts: The bot plays {card} face up and predicts that the printed value of your card is {n}.
hidden.bot_intuition: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has an active token: you spend one, draw 1 card (I deal it to you) and the bot's attack is played face up: {card} (value {value}).
fx.no_spot: There is no human_ongoing_spot in the configuration: I recognize your ONGOING in your discard pile. Configure the ONGOING zones and calibrate them with --read-only.
fx.not_ongoing: {title} is not an ONGOING: I do not count it in your ONGOING zone. Move it to your discard pile and press End action.
fx.detected: I detect {title}: the card asks you for a choice.
fx.no_actions: {title}: you do not gain its actions (an effect in play prevents it), you have {left} left.
fx.replaces: and replaces {title} (only one ONGOING per player)
fx.where_discard: in plain sight in your discard pile
fx.in_play: {title} stays in play{replaced}: leave it {where}, I keep it in mind until it expires.
fx.mandatory: This choice is mandatory (the card is already played): choose one of the panel options.
fx.cancelled: Choice cancelled: it resolves without doing anything.
fx.ability.detective_draw: OCCULT DETECTIVE: you are on the rival's start space: you may draw 2 cards (or none); choose on the panel and I deal them to you.
fx.ability.anung_discard_move: ANUNG UN RAMA: discard 1 card (mandatory) and move {hero} up to the BOOST of that card.
fx.ability.wildfire_start: WILDFIRE: discard the bottom card of your deck. If it is burning, 1 damage to another fighter in {hero}'s zone (use -1 on it; the burning card returns to your hand); if not, move {hero} up to 2 spaces.
choice.no_draw_reason: an effect in play prevents you from drawing cards, so you do not draw
choice.prompt.optional: Do you want to do it?
choice.prompt.predict: Predict the printed value of the rival card, or play face down
choice.prompt.redirect: Does {to} take the damage ({amount}) instead of {fighter}?
choice.prompt.use_effect: Do you use the effect of {title}?
choice.pick_between: Choose between {min} and {max} options and confirm.
choice.pick_max: You may choose only {max}: remove one first.
choice.restrict.attack: An effect in play prevents you from attacking now (for example, an attack as the first action of the turn): the attack buttons are hidden.
choice.restrict.draw: An effect in play prevents you from drawing cards (Cold Iron And Holy Water): the Maneuver only moves, {why}.
choice.restrict.gain_actions: An effect in play prevents you from gaining actions: schemes that give actions do not give them to you this turn.
choice.restrict.move: An effect in play prevents one of your miniatures from leaving its space: if you move it, I put it back.
ops.random_positions: {title}, at random: {which} of your hand counting from the left
narr.looks.human: you look at the bot's hand
narr.price.cannot_pay: the bot cannot pay (it lacks the cards to discard {cards}): it takes {stake} damage
narr.price.prefers: it prefers to take {stake} damage rather than lose {cards} cards
narr.price.no_change: it does not change the combat
narr.price.ignores: the bot {paid} to ignore the value of {title} (it becomes 0; {why})
narr.fighter.back: {fid} returns to the board at {spot} with {hp} HP
narr.from_deck.one: {n} card from the deck to {su} hand
narr.from_deck.other: {n} cards from the deck to {su} hand
narr.hand_to_deck: from the hand to the deck
narr.fstatus.cannot_leave_space: {fid} cannot leave its space this turn
narr.fstatus.immune_to_effect_damage: {fid} takes no effect damage this turn
narr.status.cannot_gain_actions.bot: does not gain actions this turn
narr.status.cannot_gain_actions.human: you do not gain actions this turn
narr.status.cannot_draw.bot: does not draw cards this turn
narr.status.cannot_draw.human: you do not draw cards this turn
narr.status.immune_to_effect_damage.bot: its fighters take no effect damage this turn
narr.status.immune_to_effect_damage.huma: your fighters take no effect damage this turn
tbl.where.nearest_hero: as close as possible to your hero
tbl.put: put {fid} on the board ({where}) with {hp} HP
tbl.deck.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tbl.look.first: the first {n} cards of your deck
tbl.rest.bottom_random: the rest at the bottom in random order
tbl.rest.bottom_ordered: the rest at the bottom in the order you like

play.reload_missing: TTS reloaded the game and objects from the configuration are missing: {missing}. I stop without touching the table; load the right game and resume with --resume.
play.reload_retry: TTS reloaded the game and does not answer yet ({error}); retrying.
play.reload_ok: TTS reloaded the game: GUIDs checked and panel recreated. Press End action so the bot rereads the table.
play.internal_error: Internal bot error; the game goes on. Repeat the button or use Cancel attack.
sess.hero_uncoded: The bot plays {name}. Its ability ('{ability}') is not coded in the engine yet: the bot ignores it and plays by value and boost; if it affects you, apply it yourself on the table.
sess.resume.game_over: Game over: player {winner} wins. (Press Undo game over if it is a mistake.)
sess.resume.effect: There is a pending effect choice: {prompt}. Press one of the panel options.
sess.resume.table_gate: Do what your card says on the table and press End action: the other card's effect follows.
sess.resume.combat: There is a pending combat: press Reveal or Cancel attack.
sess.resume.discard: There is a pending discard: finish it and press End action.
sess.resume.ability: Your start-of-turn ability is still pending: {wait} Do it on the table and press End action.
sess.resume.turn: It is your turn and you have {n} action(s) left.
sess.bot_retry_hint: Press End action so the bot resumes its turn.
sess.bot_deals: The bot deals its {n} starting cards.
sess.deal_yours: Draw your {n} starting cards (the bot does not deal to your seat).
setup.first.alone: You go first. Draw your 5 cards and press Ready. The bot will place afterwards, looking at where your hero is.
setup.first.single: You go first. Draw your 5 cards, place {names} on your starting space ({zone}) and press Ready. The bot will place afterwards, looking at where you put it.
setup.first.several: You go first. Draw your 5 cards, place {names} on your starting space ({zone}) and press Ready. The bot will place afterwards, looking at where you put them.
setup.then.alone: Now draw your 5 cards and press Ready.
setup.then.names: Now place {names} on your starting space ({zone}), draw your 5 cards and press Ready.
setup.retry: Press Ready to retry the setup.
err.mull_no_deck: I cannot find the bot's deck for the mulligan
err.mull_not_returned: the bot's cards have not gone back to the deck; retry with Ready
err.shuffle: I could not shuffle the bot's whole deck ({total} cards); retry with Ready
err.hand_mismatch: the bot's hand on the table ({table} cards) does not match the engine's ({engine}); retry with Ready
err.move_piece: I could not move {name}'s piece to space {space}
err.bot_pieces: the bot's pieces are not where they should be; retry with Ready
err.hero_not_at_start: {name} is not on its starting space; retry with Ready
setup.bot_places_hero: The bot places {name} (your hero) on its starting space ({zone}).
setup.none: There is no setup in progress.
setup.mull.only_setup: The mulligan is only done during setup, before pressing Ready.
setup.mull.disabled: The human mulligan is turned off in the configuration (mulligan_human).

setup.mull.go.plain: Mulligan: put your hand back in your deck, shuffle and draw {n} cards again. Then press Ready.
setup.missing_piece: {name} still has to be placed on your starting space ({zone}).
setup.draw_first: Draw your {n} cards before pressing Ready.
setup.mull_count: After your mulligan you must have {n} cards in hand (you have {count}).
sess.name_pieces_warn: Warning: I could not name the miniatures ({err}).
sess.tts_odd: TTS did not answer as expected ({err}); press the button again (End action if the bot was playing).
sess.tts_down: Table and connection error: I cannot talk to TTS ({err}); is it closed? It will be retried with the next button.
sess.setting_up: The game is still being set up: finish the placement and press Ready.
sess.effect_pending: There is a pending effect choice: answer with one of the option buttons.
sess.table_first: First do what your card says on the table and press End action: the combat goes on afterwards.
sess.ability_first: Your start-of-turn ability first, on the table: {wait} Then press End action.
sess.warn_project: Warning: I could not show a bot effect on the table ({err}).
sess.warn_check: Warning: I could not check a bot effect on the table ({err}).
err.effect_pending: there is already a pending effect choice
sess.choice_hint: {prompt}: press one of the panel options ({options}).{hint}
sess.press_end: Press End action when you are done.
look.granted: {title} lets you look at the bot's hand: press Look at bot's hand.
restart.arm: Restart game: press again within 3 seconds to confirm. All cards go back to their decks, life is restored, the pieces leave the board and the save is deleted.
restart.delete_fail: I could not delete the save {path}: {err}
restart.done: Game restarted: back to the deal, the mulligan and the placement.
err.no_dead_spot: dead_spot is missing from the configuration: there is nowhere to put the miniatures aside
restart.no_human_deck: Warning: without human_deck_guid I cannot put your cards back in your deck; do it yourself.
err.deck_incomplete: {side} deck was not left complete ({got} of {want} cards); repeat Restart game
err.reset_dirty: the restart did not leave the table clean (hands, discard piles, pieces or dials); repeat Restart game
err.reset_plan: invalid reply to the restart check: {got}
err.reset_gather: I cannot gather the {n} cards of {side} deck (I can reach {found}); I have moved nothing. Leave all its cards in the hand, the discard pile, the combat zone or the deck and repeat Restart game
sess.warn_table_behind: Warning: the bot's table does not match the engine yet ({err}); it will be retried.
maneuver.no_draw: Maneuver: {reason}. Move your miniatures and press End action.
maneuver.drew: Maneuver: you draw 1. Move your miniatures and press End action.
maneuver.empty: Maneuver: your deck is empty, you do not draw. Move your miniatures (you may boost by discarding a card) and press End action.
maneuver.dealt: Maneuver: I gave you 1 card. Move your miniatures (you may boost by discarding a card) and press End action
deal.maneuver_fail: I could not give you the Maneuver card ({err}). Draw your card by hand and press End action.
deal.confirm_fail: I could not confirm the deal of your card ({err}): look at your hand; if you do not have the new card, draw by hand and press End action.
deal.confirm_fail_short: I could not confirm the deal of your card: look at your hand. Draw your card by hand if you do not have the new one.
deal.card_fail: I could not give you the card. Draw your card by hand and press End action.
deal.after_discard: When you have discarded and press End action I will give you {cards}.
deal.fail: I could not give you {cards}{why} ({err}). Draw {cards} by hand and press End action.
deal.given_discard: I gave you {cards}{why}. What you have to discard is what you had before, not these.
deal.confirm_fail_n: I could not confirm the deal of {cards}{why} ({err}): look at your hand; if you are missing some, draw by hand and press End action.
deal.short: I could not give you {short} of the {cards}{why}. Draw {short} by hand and press End action.
deal.missing_one: The card I gave you did not reach your hand. Draw your card by hand.
deal.missing_n: The {n} cards I gave you did not reach your hand. Draw by hand.
maneuver.no_boost_value: {title} has no boost value: it does not count as a Maneuver boost.
game.over_fix: Game over: player {winner} wins. If it was an HP mistake, fix it with +1 or press Undo game over.
scheme.prompt: Scheme: leave your scheme card face up in your discard pile; I recognise it myself and apply whatever needs no choice from you. Press End action when you are done.
scheme.detect_discard: I detect {title}: applied, {gain}. Discarding your hand is up to you: they are your cards.
scheme.replaces: {title} replaces {old}: only one ONGOING is active per player.
scheme.detect_bonus: I detect {title}: +{bonus} to your combat cards until the start of your next turn (now +{total}). Moving up to 5 is up to you on the table; discard the scheme when your next turn starts.
scheme.detect_choose: I detect {title}: you have to choose {count} effects. To heal {hero} {heal:g}, press its +1 {times}; the deck is up to you on the table.
scheme.detect_gain: I detect {title}: {gain}; you resolve the rest: {text} Use +1 / -1 for HP.
scheme.detect_plain: I detect {title}: {text} Resolve it by hand; use +1 / -1 for HP.
gain.blocked: you do not gain the {n} actions (an effect in play prevents it), you have {left} left
gain.ok.one: you gain {n} action, you have {left} left
gain.ok.other: you gain {n} actions, you have {left} left
value.invalid: Invalid value: type a number between -100 and 100.
value.no_combat: There is no pending combat: the extra value only counts before Reveal, in the combat under way.
value.boost_read: The boost is read from your discard pile when you press Continue: there is no need to type a value.
sess.not_possible: Not possible now: finish the resolution under way (Reveal / End action) or wait for your turn.
sess.action_open: You already have an action open: resolve it on the table and press End action before starting another.
attack.open: There is already an attack open: put your attack card face down and press Reveal (or Cancel).
combat.bot_card_on_table: The bot's card is already on the table: press Reveal.
attack.declared: {attacker} attacks {target}: put your attack card face down in your combat zone and press Reveal.
attack.intuition_carry: UNCANNY INTUITION already applied to this attack (token spent and card drawn earlier).
cancel.flipped: The cards are already flipped: it cannot be cancelled. Press Continue (with your boost card in the discard pile) or No boost.
cancel.bot_attack: A bot attack cannot be cancelled: reveal (with no card if you have no defense).
cancel.done: Attack cancelled: the action was not spent.
cancel.intuition_again: UNCANNY INTUITION was already applied to this attack: if {attacker} attacks {target} again no other token is spent and no card is drawn again.
cancel.discard: Pending discard cancelled: the table rules and it is synchronised at the next End action.
cancel.selection: Attacker selection and extra value cleared.
err.return_card: I could not put the bot's card back in its hand; repeat Cancel attack
err.card_not_back: the bot's card has not gone back to its hand; repeat Cancel attack
cancel.put_back: I could not put {title} back in the bot's hand: put it there yourself.
reveal.many: There are {n} of your cards face down in the zone: leave just one and press Reveal.
err.no_card_down: none of your cards is face down in the combat zone
reveal.illegal: Illegal card: {err}. Change it or flip it and press Reveal again.
reveal.feint: {bot} cancels the effects of {card}: there is no boost to play.
boost.revealed_deck: {title} revealed: put the BOTTOM card of your deck in your discard pile and press Continue (No boost if your deck is empty). If it is burning, pick it up afterwards: Wildfire returns it to your hand.
boost.revealed: {title} revealed: if you want to boost, put a card from your hand in your discard pile and press Continue (or No boost).
boost.stuck: The combat could not be resolved with the current table: fix the position or the card and press Continue or No boost, or press Cancel to undo it (the cards go back face down).
boost.prompt_deck: The cards are already revealed: put the bottom card of your deck in the discard pile and press Continue, or press No boost.
boost.prompt: The cards are already revealed: put your boost card in the discard pile and press Continue, or press No boost.
boost.no_new: I see no new card in your discard pile: put it there and press Continue, or press No boost.
boost.many_new: There are {n} new cards in your discard pile ({titles}): leave only the boost one and press Continue.
boost.from_hand: The boost has to come from your hand: you had {before} cards and now you have {now} (it should be {expected}). Fix it and press Continue, or press No boost.
boost.no_value: {title} has no boost value: it does not count. Take that card out of the discard pile and put another with a boost value, or press No boost.
cancel.stuck: Combat cancelled: the action was not spent. Pick up your card from the combat zone.
combat.cant_resolve: The combat cannot be resolved: {err}. Fix the table and press Continue or No boost again, or press Cancel to undo it.
reveal.illegal_fix: Illegal card: {err}. Change it and press Reveal again.
combat.table_gate: Do what your card says on the table and press End action: then {next} is resolved.
combat.after: Resolve the effects after the combat (move pieces, discard) and press End action.
destiny.anung: Hellboy becomes ANUNG UN RAMA ({n} destinies, 6 or more): flip his miniature (it changes GUID, the bot already recognises it). His attacks add +2 and when your turn starts you discard 1 card and move up to its BOOST.
destiny.detective: Hellboy goes back to OCCULT DETECTIVE ({n} destinies): put his miniature back in its normal form.
dials.touched: I am not touching {items}: it looks changed by hand. {advice}
dials.advice: Set {label} to {want} if the engine is right; use +1/-1 if the dial is right.
dials.update_fail: I could not update the life dials ({err}); fix them by hand.
dials.check_fail: I could not check the life dials: {bad}. Fix them by hand.
dials.paused: Bot turn paused: set the dials listed above by hand and press End action so it goes on.
dials.warn: Warning: {name}'s dial shows {value:g} and the engine {hp:g}: adjust with +1 / -1 or fix the dial.
unflip.fail: I could not hide a card again: flip it face down by hand.
end.finish_boost: Finish the boost first: press Continue or No boost.
end.reveal_first: Reveal the combat under way first.
game.ended: The game is over (Undo game over if it is an HP mistake).
end.no_scheme: I saw no new scheme card in your discard pile: resolve the scheme by hand.
combat.gone: Combat cancelled: {name} is no longer in play. The action was not spent.
revive.place: Place {name} on {where} (it is not on the board).
revive.cannot: I cannot bring {name} back: its miniature is not on the board. Place it and repeat.
undo.none: There is no game over to undo.
undo.done: Game reopened: fallen heroes come back with 1 HP. Fix the HP with +1 / -1.
discard.hand_fail: I could not discard your hand ({failure}): discard it by hand.
discard.hand_done.one: I discard your hand ({n} card) for {reason}.
discard.hand_done.other: I discard your hand ({n} cards) for {reason}.
wildfire.hint: Wildfire: leave the burning card in your discard pile, press End action and then pick it up again (that way it is counted and the bot knows which one goes back to your hand).
discard.not_seen: I do not see {titles} in your discard pile yet: put it there and press End action.
wildfire.assumed: Wildfire: I take the discard as done (burning cards go back to your hand).
wildfire.ask: I do not see the discard on the table yet. If you discarded burning cards that went back to your hand, press End action again and I will take it as done.
discard.missing: You still have to discard {n} card(s); take the cards already played to the discard pile too.
turn.look_first: Before ending the turn you can look at the bot's hand (Look at bot's hand); press End action to finish.
discard.limit: Discard {n} card(s) down to {limit} and press End action (Cancel attack cancels the discard).
turn.bot: End of your turn. Bot's turn.
wildfire.not_found: I cannot find {title} in the bot's deck to show it: I go on without a scene.
wildfire.show_fail: I could not show the Wildfire card ({err}); I go on with the turn.
wildfire.burning: It is a fire card: it goes back to {liz}'s hand
wildfire.moves.one: Not a fire card: {liz} moves {n} space
wildfire.moves.other: Not a fire card: {liz} moves {n} spaces
wildfire.stays: Not a fire card: {liz} stays where she is
anung.start: ANUNG UN RAMA: the bot discards {title} (BOOST {boost}) and moves {name} up to {boost}: {where}.
anung.start_still: ANUNG UN RAMA: the bot discards {title} (BOOST {boost}) and does not move {name}.
detective.start: OCCULT DETECTIVE: Hellboy starts the turn on your starting space; the bot draws {n}.
bot.exhaust: Empty deck: the bot draws and each of its fighters loses {damage} HP.
bot.card_down: The bot's {title} was already face down on the table: I count it as played. Press Reveal.
dials.still_off: The dials still do not match the engine; I go on with the turn, check them.
medusa.gaze: Medusa's ability: 1 damage to {name} (HP from {before:g} to {after:g}).
attack.defend_now: Leave your defense face down (or nothing) and press Reveal.
attack.bot_defend: The bot attacks {target} with {attacker}: leave your defense face down (or nothing) and press Reveal.
scheme.expired: {label}: the +{n} to your combat cards expires. Discard the scheme.
turn.late: Your turn has started, but the bot's table does not match yet ({err}); it will be retried with your next button.
turn.ability_wait: {wait} Do it on the table and press End action: until then the other buttons wait.
err.identity: I cannot read the identity (images) of {side} deck: without it I touch no card
err.identity_reply: invalid answer to the identities reading: {got}
sess.tts_failed: TTS failed in {tag} ({err}); check the table by hand.
sess.panel_prep_fail: I could not prepare the panel state ({err}).
sess.table_update_fail: I could not update the table at the end ({err}).
sess.panel_update_fail: I could not update the panel after the checks ({err}).
err.snapshot: the table snapshot is not valid
st.restart_armed: Press Restart game again to confirm
st.setup_wait: Setup - place your sidekick, draw 5 and press Ready
st.setup_bot: Setup - the bot is preparing its table
st.bot_turn_paused: Bot's turn - paused, press End action
st.ability: {head} - start-of-turn ability on the table, then End action
st.boost_stuck: {title} unresolved: fix the table and press Continue or No boost, or Cancel
st.boost_wait: {title} revealed: put a card in your discard and press Continue or No boost
st.wait.table: your card's effect on the table and End action
look.not_granted: No card lets you look at the bot's hand now.
look.already: The bot's hand is already in view.
look.when: You can only look at the bot's hand on your turn, during a combat or right after one.
look.unreflected: The bot's table has moves not shown yet: press End action (or Cancel) before looking at its hand.
look.empty: The bot has no cards in hand.
look.no_cards: I see no cards in the bot's hand on the table.
look.shown: Bot's hand ({n}): ping (Tab) the card to discard. You can also flip one face down and press End action; Cancel puts them back without discarding.
look.tts_unconfirmed: TTS did not confirm that it laid out the cards ({err}); check the table and press Cancel to pick them up.
look.partial: I could only lay out {n} of {total} cards; the rest stay in its hand.
look.none_shown: There are no bot cards in view: press Look at bot's hand.
look.bad_ping: That ping was not on a card of the bot's row.
look.face_down: There are {n} cards face down in the row: leave exactly one (the one you discard) and press End action, or ping (Tab) it.
look.discarded: The bot discards {title} and returns the rest of its hand.
look.returned: Bot's hand returned without discarding anything.
look.forced: Look closed by force ({why}): the table rules. Pick up by hand any bot cards that are not in its hand (the ones in the row) and put them back; press End action to synchronise.
look.why_stacked: no card of the row responds
look.fail_missing: that card was not in the row on the table
look.table_failed: The table did not make the change ({fail}): the bot's hand is still in view; repeat the ping or Cancel.
look.not_in_discard: {title} is not yet visible in the bot's discard pile; if it does not arrive, press End action.
err.unknown_card: unknown card in the bot's hand: {err}
adopt.table: I adopt what the table shows for the bot (hand, discard pile and positions). If a card is missing or extra, fix it on the table and press End action.
adopt.discard: The table rules: {title} is in the bot's discard pile (because of an effect of the opponent); I count it as discarded.
adopt.stray: The bot's {title} was loose on the table: I put it back in its hand.
err.discard_missing: I did not find the bot's cards {ids} on the table to discard them
err.deck_dealt: the bot's deck dealt {dealt} of {n} cards
err.table_mismatch: the bot's table does not match the engine (hand or discard pile); retry End action
err.move_guid: I could not move {name}'s piece ({guids}) to space {space}: the GUID does not exist on the table
bury.done_mine: {name} falls: I have moved it off the board.
bury.done_human: {name} falls: I have put it aside.
bury.failed_mine: {name} falls: remove its miniature from the table (I could not move it aside myself).
bury.failed_human: {name} (yours) falls: remove its miniature from the table.
revive.back: {name} is back in the game: I placed it on {where}.
revive.place_manual: Place {name} on {where} (I could not move it myself); then press End action.
warn.missing: I cannot find {name}'s piece ({guid}) on the table; I keep its last space.
warn.off: {name} is off the board ({dist:.1f} from the nearest space, {zone}): if it died, press Remove; if not, put it back on the board.
warn.pinned: {name} cannot leave its place ({where}; effect in play): put it back, I keep it there.
warn.draw: Your hand has grown and an effect in play stops you from drawing ({reason}): put the card back in your deck. Meanwhile I count on it.
sess.save_fail: I could not save the game to {path}: {err}
err.card_not_in_hand: {title} is not in the bot's hand on the table; action cancelled
err.card_not_out: {title} did not leave the bot's hand (it is not on its card spot); action cancelled
bot.scheme_tail: puts {cards} from the discard pile at the bottom of its deck
bot.scheme_shuffle: shuffles {cards} from the discard pile into its deck
bot.return_hand: Put {cards} from your hand back in your deck and shuffle ({cause}; you choose them).
tr.draw_human: You draw {cards}{why}: do it on the table.
tr.discard_named: Put {titles} from your hand into your discard pile ({cause}) and press End action.
tr.discard_count: Discard {n} card(s) ({reason}) and press End action.{hint}
tr.left_play: {title} leaves play ({cause}): it stays in your discard pile.
tr.left_play_hand: {title} leaves play ({cause}): move it from your ONGOING zone to your discard pile and press End action.
tr.left_play_ping: {title} leaves play ({cause}): watch the ping, I will move it to your discard pile.
tr.moved.moves.done: {name} moves to {space}: I moved it myself (bot effect).
tr.moved.returns.done: {name} returns to the board at {space}: I moved it myself (bot effect).
tr.moved.moves.manual: {name} moves to {space} because of a bot effect: I could not move its miniature, move it yourself.
tr.moved.returns.manual: {name} returns to the board at {space} because of a bot effect: I could not move its miniature, move it yourself.
tr.where.you.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
tr.where.you.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.where.bot.shuffle: into your deck and I shuffle it
tr.where.bot.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.where.hand.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.where.hand.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
tr.where.done.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.bot_what.hand: from the bot's hand to its deck
tr.bot_what.bottom: from the bot's discard pile to the bottom of its deck
tr.bot_what.shuffled: from the bot's discard pile to its deck (shuffled)
tr.short: I could not move {titles} {what}: do it yourself.
tr.bot_puts_hand_bottom: The bot puts {cards} from its hand at the bottom of its deck.
tr.bot_puts_hand_shuffle: The bot puts {cards} from its hand into its deck and shuffles it.
tr.bot_puts_bottom: The bot puts {titles} from its discard pile at the bottom of its deck.
tr.bot_shuffles: The bot shuffles {titles} from its discard pile into its deck.
tr.gone: {titles} is no longer in your discard pile: I take it that it is already {where} ({cause}).
tr.cannot_touch_deck: I cannot touch your deck ({err}): put {titles} from your discard pile {where} yourself.
tr.return_bot_fail: I could not put {title} back in the bot's hand: put it there yourself.
tr.pickup: Pick up {titles} from your discard pile into your hand ({cause}).
tr.bot_recovers: The bot takes {title} from its discard pile back into its hand.
tr.not_loose: I cannot find {title} loose in the bot's discard pile: put it in its hand yourself.
tr.bot_takes: The bot takes {cards} from its deck.
tr.token_fail_add: I could not take a {name} token from the table: put an active one next to {hero} yourself.
tr.token_fail_remove: I could not remove the {name} token from {hero}: remove it yourself.
tr.token_missing: {hero} (bot) spends a {name} token that I do not see on the table: remove it yourself.
tr.form_human: {head}: change its miniature to that form yourself.
tr.form_both: {head}: I change its miniature and flip its ability token; ping on both.
tr.form_one: {head}: I change its miniature; ping on it.
tr.form_fail_mini: I could not change {name}'s miniature to {form}: change it yourself.
tr.form_fail_token: I could not flip {name}'s ability token: flip it yourself.
tr.ongoing_nospot: The bot leaves {title} in play (ONGOING); without bot_ongoing_spot in the configuration the card stays in its hand on the table.
tr.ongoing_fail: I could not put {title} in the bot's ONGOING zone: put it there yourself.
tr.ongoing_placed: The bot leaves {title} in play: it puts it face up in its ONGOING zone.
err.not_attack_type: {title} is of type {type}: it cannot be used to attack
err.not_defense_type: {title} is of type {type}: it cannot be used to defend
err.cannot_attack_first: {fid} cannot attack as the first action of the turn
err.boost_impossible: {title} has no boost value: it cannot be used to boost
err.tts_no_value: TTS returned no value (it is busy, paused or reloading: check the TTS window)
cf.redirect: {victim} takes the combat damage instead of {target}
cf.bot_no_resolve: {title}: the bot does not resolve this effect (interpreter off): {text}
